items.title: Retreaded tractor tyres at 2.5%; other retreaded tyres at 9%
items.summary: Notification 02/2026 adds retreaded tractor tyres at 2.5% (Schedule I, S.No 272A), keeps other retreaded or used tyres at 9%, and widens the fertiliser entry to include seaweed-based bio-stimulants.
items.reference: Notification 02/2026-Central Tax (Rate), Schedule I S.No 237 and 272A; Schedule II S.No 138

items.title: Psyllium seeds (isabgol) added at nil rate
items.summary: Notification 03/2026 adds psyllium seeds under heading 1211 90 13 to the nil-rate schedule of notification 10/2025 as S.No 87A.

items.title: Hotel, restaurant, EV transport and delivery service conditions revised
items.summary: Notification 06/2026 revises the input tax credit conditions for hotel, restaurant and outdoor catering services. It adds 2.5% entries for passenger and goods transport in electrically operated vehicles, and changes the delivery service entry. It also updates the goods transport agency definition.

items.title: New exemptions: SPFO services, toll collection, coffee curing, storage of seeds and grains
items.summary: Notification 07/2026 adds nil-rated entries for services by the Seamen's Provident Fund Organisation, toll collection by government bodies, curing of coffee for growers, and storage of cereals, pulses, fruits, vegetables and seeds meant for sowing. It also adds a definition of 'seed'.

items.title: Reverse charge extended to used cooking oil, plastic and tyre waste, and e-waste
items.summary: Notification 04/2026 adds used cooking oil, waste and scrap of plastics, waste and scrap of tyres, and electrical and electronics waste to the list where tax is payable by the registered recipient when the supplier is unregistered.

items.title: 'Nominated agency' definition updated for exports
items.summary: Notification 05/2026 changes the definition of 'nominated agency' to refer to entities listed in Appendix 4B of the DGFT Handbook of Procedures, as amended from time to time.

items.title: HSN codes restated for some beverages
items.summary: Notification 01/2026 changes the HSN entries for certain beverages in Schedule I (2.5%) and Schedule III (20%). The notification changes the codes listed in each entry. Check the entry for your product before invoicing.

items.title: DPDP Act: first provisions in force; main duties from May 2027
items.summary: Notification G.S.R. 843(E) brings some provisions of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 into force. Main obligations for data fiduciaries are scheduled for 13 May 2027. The DPDP Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 846(E)) also commence in stages.

items.title: GST rate rationalisation for goods and services
items.summary: Central tax rates were revised across many goods and services from 22 September 2025 through notifications 9/2025, 10/2025 and 15/2025. Check the schedule entry for your item.
